12 days until the August SAT.

A system is two lines and a picture. Where they cross is the answer — and when they never cross, Desmos shows you that too, which is the entire no-solution question.

Save this one — it's the whole topic in one place. Seva's practice tests have the same calculator built in, so you can drill these until they're reflex. Free trial — link in bio.

slides.title: Change = to < and it shades
slides.tip: Everything shaded satisfies the inequality. Test any point: if it's in the shading, it works.

slides.tip: The darker wedge is where both shadings overlap — that's the solution to the system.
